name: Ky Co
summary: Cove of white sand nearly 25 km from the city: swim the clear shallows for about an hour. It sits in xã Nhơn Lý, with a natural pool where children catch shells and small fish. The posted price is a range of 30,000–60,000 đồng. Read the board before you pay.
getThere: Nearly 25 km from the city, in xã Nhơn Lý.

notice.title: Read the price board
notice.body: The posted range is 30,000–60,000 đồng. Ask at the board whether that covers the gate, the boat, or both. Eo Gió’s ticket is a separate 25,000 đồng.

gettingThere: The cove is nearly 25 km from the city. The description places it in xã Nhơn Lý. The address line reads Phường Quy Nhơn Đông.

legs.body: Nearly 25 km to xã Nhơn Lý. Confirm the road and the boat when you leave.
